profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Don't make the same mistake twice and become more focused on the solution then the problem.

positions.title: Computer Lab Monitor
positions.description: Observe and Insure computers are functioning,  provide assistant to anyone who uses them, and follow lab policies. Any issues are instantly reported to management

positions.title: flooring/garden sales associate
positions.description: maintaining product aisles, and provide customer assistance in finding products.

positions.title: Technician
positions.description:
Travelled to several Chase Bank locations and assisted in the removal, data wipe, and complete replacement of workstations. Tasks include: 
data wiping
disassemble old workstations and replace them with new ones
repair printers and replace them with new parts.
reload disk images

positions.title: Computer Helpdesk Analyst
positions.description: Provide on-campus internet, hardware, software and operating system support to students, faculty, and staff members

positions.title: CISS Workstation Technician
positions.description:
Provided over the phone and in-person technical support university computer labs and selected faculty and staff members. Tasks include: 
Operating System repair and reinstallation
Workstation replacement
Application support
Network support

positions.title: Secretary
positions.description:
Provide and record documentation of fraternity active. Tasks include:  
Communication between officers and active members
Ensure paperwork is sent to headquarters
Ensure roster is updated
Chapter minutes are posted
